description.en:
She was betrayed by those she trusted—then executed for a crime she didn’t commit. But fate isn’t finished with her yet.

Celeste Golding had endured a hard life. Orphaned at a young age, she suffered the cruelty of her brother’s household, clinging to hope and rising to fame as a gifted Star Beast Tamer. Just when it seemed like her courage had paid off, she was falsely accused of abusing the very beasts she loved—and sentenced to death.

But when her life ends, something incredible happens: Celeste wakes up in her childhood body, with all her memories intact.

This time, she refuses to be the victim.

Armed with knowledge of the future and a newfound resolve, Celeste begins her second life determined to protect the ones she loves, tame the mightiest of Star Beasts, and rewrite her story on her own terms. But as shadows from her past stir once more, can she avoid the traps of fate—or will her enemies find her again?
description.ja: セレスト・ゴールディングは幼いころに両親を亡くして以来、兄夫婦とその娘に苛められながらも健気に生き、星獣使いとなり活躍していたが、星獣を不当に扱ったといういわれなき罪で死刑に…だがなぜか幼いころに戻っていて!?全てを奪われたひとりの少女が己の「人生」を取り戻していく…異世界やり直し物語！
